test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number-symbol series and answer the question that follows.

(Left) 1 3 & > 3 $ 8 4 ! > 9 3 4 1 @ $ 3 5 > @ # 2 9 8 6 9 ! 9 (Right)

If all the numbers are dropped from the series, which of the following symbols will be the seventh to the left of the third from the right?
solution:
Given series: (Left) 1 3 & > 3 $ 8 4 ! > 9 3 4 1 @ $ 3 5 > @ # 2 9 8 6 9 ! 9 (Right)

If all the numbers are dropped from the series then we get:

(Left) & > $ ! > @ $ > @ # ! (Right)

So, the third from the right = @

And, the seventh to the left of the third from the right = **>**

Hence, the correct answer is ">".
